decisions.decision: Rewrote UAT-7-29 criterion 5 to assert the node came to rest where the drag put it (pre + rendered_delta/zoom), and red-proved it by displacing the expectation 300px

A tautological criterion is worse than a missing one: a missing one fails a count, a tautological one passes the count, the test and every gate while adding zero falsifiability, under a Result line claiming five independent assertions.
